title: ICU localization gate
job: Validate nested ICU message arguments, selectors, plural branches and protected tokens across translations.
method: A bounded nested MessageFormat parser rather than a flat placeholder regex.
recovery: Repair the exact missing argument/category/brace; semantic translation review remains separate.
acceptance: Nested plurals and quoted literal braces must not be mistaken for missing or extra arguments.
novelty_scope: Algorithms and domain operations have established prior art. The evaluated contribution is the bounded executable resource and small-model integration, not invention of the underlying task.

problem_evidence.evidence: User requested inexpensive AI resources that improve completion of specific domain jobs.
The linked existing tools and their manuals document the recurring task and established solutions. No user interview or unmeasured frustration count is invented.

distinctive_capability: A bounded nested MessageFormat parser rather than a flat placeholder regex. An offline executable can be called by a small model and checked against an explicit task contract.
